verdict.rationale: Docs directly state custom dashboards over cost, latency, volume, and quality/eval-score metrics (langfuse-docs-33, langfuse-docs-38), backed by a Metrics API v2 for querying aggregate cost/usage/latency/volume/score metrics (langfuse-docs-15/28/65) and threshold-based alerting (langfuse-docs-4, langfuse-docs-53). Error tracking is implied via trace-level cost/latency logging (langfuse-docs-54) though not explicitly named as a dashboard metric. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of dashboard customization depth and explicit 'error metric' dashboarding beyond generic trace logging.
